extraction_notes: Multi-variant datasheet covering RS2A through RS2M (Zhuhai Hongjiacheng Technology co., Ltd, www.ichjc.com), SMA/DO-214AC surface-mount fast recovery rectifier; RS2M column values used: VRRM=1000V, VRMS=700V, VDC=1000V, device marking code RS2M (page 1).

Key maximum ratings (page 1): IF(AV)=2.0A at 60Hz sinewave resistance load per Fig.1, IFSM=50.0A at t=8.3ms half-sine, Tstg=-55 to +150degC, Tj=-55 to +150degC, typical RthJA=75degC/W and RthJL=35degC/W. Polarity: cathode line denotes the cathode end.

Grouped-cell columns in the electrical table (page 2) were resolved by measuring cell-divider pixel positions on a 200 dpi rasterization against the header column centers: Trr dividers fall between RS2G|RS2J and RS2J|RS2K, so Trr = 150ns (RS2A-RS2G), 250ns (RS2J), 500ns (RS2K-RS2M); the CJ divider falls between RS2G|RS2J, so CJ = 18pF (RS2A-RS2G), 11pF (RS2J-RS2M). RS2M takes Trr=500ns and CJ=11pF.
Second reverse leakage spec not representable in the single reverse_current slot: IR2=100uA maximum at VR=VDC, Ta=125degC (page 2); both IR1 and IR2 are single family-wide values.

No explicit breakdown voltage or breakdown test current is specified anywhere in the datasheet, so breakdown fields are null; Fig.4 reverse curves end at 100% of rated VRRM with no avalanche knee shown.

Curves digitized programmatically from a 400 dpi rasterization of page 2 with axis calibration against labeled major gridlines (curve traced as the thick dark run per pixel column, sampled off gridlines). All four figures show one family-wide curve set with no per-variant splits.
Fig.3 (forward V-I): voltages at target currents read at sub-pixel-interpolated crossings; estimated uncertainty about +/-0.01V. Curve spans approximately 0.545V at 0.01A to 1.68V at about 13.4A.
Fig.2 (surge): x-axis decade width calibrated from the heavy gridlines at 1 and 10 and the 100 label position (the plot frame extends past 100 cycles); uncertainty about +/-0.5A.

Fig.4 (reverse leakage): x-axis 100% gridline is inset from the right frame edge (frame extends to about 115% unlabeled); both curves start at about 9-10% of rated VRRM; log-axis current uncertainty about +/-5%. To convert x-values to absolute volts for RS2M multiply by 10 (100% = 1000V).
Fig.1 derating is flat at 2.0A from 0 to 135degC lead temperature, then derates linearly to 0A at 150degC; intermediate points on the linear segment are interpolated from the two segment endpoints.
